run_benchmark_llm_models: run a benchmark comparing multiple LLM models on response time and cost for a list of questions
run_benchmark_with_system_prompt: run the LLM benchmark with a custom system prompt via the --system-prompt CLI option
refactor_benchmark_models_list: refactor the benchmark script to add or remove LLM models from the models list
refactor_benchmark_questions: refactor the benchmark script to swap in a different list of questions to test
review_benchmark_main: review the main benchmark function that iterates over models and questions using litellm completion
